$description: Generated by v2/tools/build-tokens.mjs from v2/figma/semantic.txt and v2/figma/primitives.txt. Do not edit; change Figma or ds-tokens/overrides.json and rebuild. Semantic collection "Border", mode "default". Modes are combined by ds-tokens/tokens.resolver.json. Tokens marked com.souvenir.proposed come from ds-tokens/proposed/tokens.json and are not in Figma.

sm.$description: The edge of a control or a divider.

$extensions.com.souvenir.why: The Border collection is empty. Every control needs an edge width.

md.$description: The edge of a selected or invalid control, and the active tab's underline.

$extensions.com.souvenir.why: A state shown only by a colour change of a 1 pixel line is easy to miss.

width.$description: The thickness of the focus ring.

$extensions.com.souvenir.why: WCAG 2.4.13 measures a focus indicator against a 2 pixel perimeter.

offset.$description: The gap between a control and its focus ring.

$extensions.com.souvenir.why: The gap keeps the blue ring readable beside a pink or black fill.
